name: Summer Ice Lake
description: At the height of summer, the lake is covered with clear, warm ice.

scenes.name: Warm Ice
scenes.description: The ice feels warm to the touch and yields slightly underfoot.

scenes.name: Captured Sunbeam
scenes.description: A golden strip of light moves slowly beneath the ice.

scenes.name: Summer Reeds
scenes.description: Green reeds full of dragonflies grow along the edges of the frozen lake.
